SUMMARY:
Riemann--Roch, divisors, and the adelic genus.

Cluster-P substrate, all sorry-free and axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]:

(a) UNCONDITIONAL class invariance (Adelic/ClassInvariance.lean) -- multiplication by g is a
    k-linear automorphism of K(X) carrying chart sections, coboundary and overlap onto their
    shifted counterparts, so ell, h1 and chi are functions of the linear-equivalence class, with
    no gate, no finiteness and no ledger-exactness input.

(b) UNCONDITIONAL degree and drop bounds (Adelic/SectionBounds.lean) -- deg_k as a bundled
    AddMonoidHom, residue-degree positivity, positive degree for nonzero effective divisors, and
    the drop sandwich ell(D) <= ell(D+P) <= ell(D)+[kappa(P):k].

(c) THE CLOSED CHI-LEDGER, PROVED (Adelic/LedgerClosure.chi_eq_of_bump, run 0055 s0008) --
    chi(D) = chi(0) + deg_k D at EVERY Weil divisor, from the one-point bump alone. This was
    recorded as open by three sessions, with a correct-but-irrelevant obstruction argument; the
    resolution is that hbump admits an ARBITRARY base divisor, so the telescope runs onto the
    base D rather than up from 0. hledger is therefore no longer an independent lane input, and
    six ledger-free restatements of the lane's conclusions are in LedgerClosure section 2.

(d) CONDITIONAL single-field bounded H1 vanishing (Adelic/BoundedVanishing.lean) --
    exists_bound_subsingleton_h1Mod, b = deg_k D0 + 1 - chi(0). Open inputs now TWO, not three,
    and both are one-point local statements: the bump, and the one-point peel. The peel is FREE
    off the overlap (peel_pointDivisor_of_notMem_overlap), so its content sits at overlap points
    only -- a small saving, since the overlap of a 2-affine cover of an irreducible curve is dense.

(e) PROVED global generation (Adelic/GlobalGeneration.lean) -- the evaluation map
    Gamma(D)/Gamma(D-P) -> kappa(P) is onto exactly when the section drop is maximal, which the
    ledger converts into a PAIR of vanishings. Conditional on the same inputs as (d).

(f) THE RESIDUE LANE, CLOSED (Adelic/ResidueField.lean) -- residueDeg = 1 and node N14's
    residue-finiteness gate both DISCHARGED on curve hypotheses; deg_k = deg unconditional;
    ell(D) = deg D + 1 - g for deg large on the GEOMETRIC degree.

THE THREE GAPS, KEPT APART (the task requires this separation):
  1. single-field vanishing -- conditional on the bump, one base vanishing, and the overlap peel;
  2. extension uniformity -- OPEN. UniformlyBounded
